items.title: How receptive is Marcus, depending on how Maya raises it?
items.description: Maya's real numbers: raised privately (1 person in the room) with strong load-test evidence, this model puts receptiveness around 85%. Drag the audience size up to see what happens as the same concern gets raised in front of more people, and drag evidence strength down to see what happens with only a gut feeling instead of a load-test chart.
items.compute: let receptiveness = 45 + params.evidenceStrength * 0.45 - (params.audienceSize - 1) * 5.5; receptiveness = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(receptiveness))); return { receptiveness };
